pages.title: Nucleotide Cluster
pages.text: A pocket of free nucleotides, glowing faintly. Found in the Nucleus of Inner Space. Mined, it gives Nucleotides; matrix and nucleotides lay more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the rock (mine it for its drop).$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.
